column1: # Game profile of Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze (Switch, update 1.0.2 = v131072). Plays on the Mac (boot, the title, the menus, the intro cinematic, the first level at 60 fps)
# Retro Studios' engine (RFRM forms: MaterialArchive.arc and .pak archives) on SDK 4.4.0, NVN; subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library, and sdk / subsdk0 are Mario Kart 8 Deluxe's builds.
# Its shaders are SNVN program records in MaterialArchive.arc, in the packs' MTRL resources and in a startup archive LZSS-compressed into main (shader_split.py rfrm_shaders /
# retro_main_forms). What the host needed for it is general (README.md: a heap request beyond the heap region, CPU-uncached texture storage, the renderer's kernel event, an oe getter)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# no system resource: nninitStartup binary-searches SetMemoryHeapSize between 3 and 6 GB and settles on 3.09 GB (the pool less the rewritten modules) in the 4 GB layout's
# 3.25 GB heap region; about 2 GB resident and 1 GB of Metal allocations in the first level on the Mac
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 24,098 shaders (11,644 vertex, 11,734 pixel, 720 geometry): MaterialArchive.arc, the MTRL resources of PreLoadPak, UIPak and the world / level packs, the startup archive and 294 GLSLC
# outputs in main; 11,640 vertex / pixel pairs
